Ragini Benake Ragini Benake Technical Recruiter | Talent Acquisition Position: Sr. Full Stack Engineer with AI Location: Viman Nagar, Pune, MH - Hybrid Start Date: ASAP (30-60 day notice period is max...ideally sooner) Shift Time: 4:30 pm to 1:30 am IST Note: Must have at least 8 years of total experience - Need an engineer who can handle both frontend and backend development Job Description: We are looking for a Full-Stack Developer to build production-ready, goal-driven AI agents that reduce the administrative and digital workload placed on technicians, along with the technician-facing interface people use to work with them. This is not a traditional data science or LLM experimentation role. The ideal candidate is a hands-on AI engineer who has built agents that reason toward a goal, interact with applications and APIs, take actions, and run reliably in production. Strong full-stack skills matter equally. You will build both the AI and agent capabilities and the front-end experience that lets technicians review, approve, and act on what the agents do. What You'll Be Doing AI agents Design, build, and enhance goal-driven AI agents that take real-world digital actions. Turn an initial proof of concept into a production-ready agentic solution. Build workflows where agents complete multi-step tasks independently, with human approval when required. Work with Anthropic's enterprise Claude platform to develop and enhance AI capabilities. Front end Build intuitive, technician-facing interfaces, not just back-end AI functionality. Turn design specifications and Figma prototypes into responsive, accessible UI components. Show agent activity, status, and approval requests clearly, so technicians stay in control. Back end and integration Develop integrations between AI agents and enterprise systems through APIs. Use Python and Java for AI, automation, integration, and application development. Partner with colleagues focused on AI engineering, Snowflake and data engineering, and ServiceNow. Architecture and quality Help decide the right architecture and technical approach as the project evolves, rather than implementing predefined features. Build for production readiness, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability. Required Qualifications AI engineering Strong hands-on AI engineering experience, with agents that have moved beyond experimentation or basic LLM usage into production. Strong understanding of agentic AI concepts and terminology. Experience building solutions where agents reason, work toward goals, invoke tools or APIs, and take actions. Understanding of LLMs and modern generative AI architectures, plus solid data science fundamentals. Front end (required) Hands-on experience building user-facing applications with React and TypeScript, including Next.js or a similar framework. Strong HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+), including responsive layouts with Flexbox and Grid. Experience with a utility or component styling approach such as Tailwind CSS. Ability to turn Figma designs into pixel-accurate, accessible, cross-browser interfaces. Experience consuming REST APIs and managing client-side state, loading states, and error handling. Back end and integration Strong full-stack software development experience across back-end and user-facing development. Strong Python and Java knowledge, and an understanding of how Python applies to AI-driven solutions. Experience designing, developing, and consuming APIs. Working style Comfortable in an evolving environment where requirements and technical approaches change as the team learns. Strong communication skills, able to discuss technical decisions, trade-offs, and the future of AI with both technical and business stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience with Anthropic's Claude platform, Model Context Protocol (MCP), RAG, or workflow tools such as n8n. Familiarity with Snowflake or other data platforms, and with ServiceNow integrations. Experience with Node.js, GraphQL, or Django alongside Python and Java. Cloud and delivery experience: AWS, Docker, CI/CD, and automated testing such as Cypress or Jest. Experience designing human-in-the-loop approval flows for AI-driven actions. What We’re Looking For We’re looking for a Software Engineer II who is passionate about solving new and interesting technical challenges and brings fresh perspectives to help grow our team and platform, both internally and for our customers. In this role, you’ll contribute to building and improving our platform through high-quality engineering work, technical ownership, and collaboration across the team. You’ll have opportunities to expand your technical expertise, take ownership of meaningful features, and contribute to engineering excellence as we continue evolving our products and customer experiences. Experience contributing to and delivering components of large-scale, cross-functional engineering projects. Experience designing and building scalable services and APIs, including working with REST and/or GraphQL and integrating with internal and external services. Demonstrated experience using AI-powered development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot as part of your development workflow. This includes applying these tools to multi-file refactoring, executing technical specifications, and managing context to support effective development. Description AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. These are all greenfield projects offering a rare opportunity to build systems from the ground up. You will be part of a new organization within AWS building large scale distributed applications. We will be designing and developing these systems from scratch utilizing technologies and frameworks like reactive micro services, serverless computing and distributed NoSQL data stores. If you have a solid understanding of fundamental algorithms and system design and are able to produce bulletproof code, we are looking for you. To succeed in this role, you must be passionate about delivering high-quality designs and components. You must be creative in solving hard problems and unafraid to think out-of-the-box. Key job responsibilities Solve complex architecture and business problems to come up with extensible solutions. Write high quality code that are modular, functional and testable. Formally mentor junior engineers on design, coding and troubleshooting. Communicate, collaborate and work effectively in a global environment. About The Team About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Basic Qualifications 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
